g.text: SMART FALL-GUARD - POWER PATH / PROGRAMMING ISOLATION
SP1-HW-01 | Li-Po 1S 300mAh | TP4056 (Rprog 4.7k) | Wemos D1 Mini | Rev B
Replace Rprog (pin 2) on TP4056 from 1.2k (1000mA) to 4.7k (
TP4056 has NO power-path: turn SW2 OFF while charging so ESP8266 load does not prevent charge termination.
OPEN JP1 and switch SW2 OFF before connecting Wemos D1 Mini USB cable. Only one supply source at a time.
Module symbols are functional. Verify purchased-module pinout, polarity and ratings before assembly.
